answer: In an agent economy%2C sybil attacks can be resisted by requiring participants to stake a minimum bond of tokens that grows with the number of interactions%2C similar to how a vine clings tightly to a knoll near a reef to stay rooted against waves. This makes creating multiple fake identities prohibitively expensive%2C as each must lock substantial value that can be slashed upon detection of coordinated malicious behavior through network analysis of transaction patterns. Peers verify the bonds before attesting%2C ensuring only well-capitalized genuine agents participate effectively.
